subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

My boss keeps telling me / all the time/ that money / doesn't grows on trees.
solution:
The erroneous part is option 4) i.e. 'doesn't grows on trees.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part 'doesn't grows on trees'.
 
• We can note that the erroneous part contains the be verb 'doesn't' as the subject 'money' is an uncountable (which will be followed by verb in singular form)
 
• Therefore we have to use the verb** 'grow' i**nstead of 'grows'. (To make verb in singular form -addition of s/es to the main verb )
 
• In the given sentence we need to use 'grow' in place of 'grows' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct sentence:__ *My boss keeps telling me all the time that money **doesn't grow on trees.***
